text:
Maya Patel: hi team — Maya here, first day! I'm trying to get access to the GCP project we'll use for latency tests in asia-northeast4. I opened the new-hires form but it only lists EU projects. Can someone advise which project id and exact IAM roles I should request? Also we need billing linked for an EU test bucket. cc @Ryan Cho

cloud-ops-bot: automated invite: SSO account provisioned for maya.p@redwood.ai — please finish set up at https://sso.redwood.ai/setup.

Ryan Cho: welcome Maya! Project is `redwood-infra-lab-asia`. For access ask for `roles/viewer` + `roles/storage.objectAdmin` for the bucket and `roles/compute.instanceAdmin` if you'll spin VMs. If you need GPUs ping infra for GPU roles. If you paste the exact project id you see in the form I'll confirm.

Maya Patel: thanks! The form shows `redwood-temp-eu-staging` only — I can't find the asia project. I also need billing linked so CI can write results to the EU bucket (regulatory reasons).

Sarah Jansen: Hey Maya — people-ops can't link billing. For billing link we need an approved cost center and a request in the billing console. @Ryan and @Leo, can infra confirm the cost-center and whether we can use the existing EU billing account?

Leo Martins: we have an EU billing account `billing-006-eu`. To link, infra needs the project number (not id). You can get it with `gcloud projects describe PROJECT_ID --format='value(projectNumber)'`. Example:
```
# get project number
gcloud projects describe redwood-infra-lab-asia --format='value(projectNumber)'
```
Also, if you need CMEK/KMS to encrypt results, request `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the key resource. I'll initiate cross-project billing once Ryan confirms project number.

Ryan Cho: we generally open an internal ticket with subject `billing-link: <project-number>` and include cost center `ENG-RN`. @Maya if you paste the project number here I'll create the ticket.

Maya Patel: got it — I ran the command after SSO and got `123456789012`. Also need access to `asia-northeast4` zones — sometimes org policy blocks regions. Should I file a separate request?

Leo Martins: thanks — I'll start the billing link. For region permissions, we usually whitelist `asia-northeast4` at the org level for service usage. I'll check org policy; if blocked we'll do an exception and update this thread within the hour.

Ryan Cho: created ticket INFRA-7421 with details (projectNumber=123456789012, roles: viewer+storage.objectAdmin+compute.instanceAdmin, cost center ENG-RN). ETA for billing link ~ 2-4 hours. @Maya once billing is linked you may also need `roles/bigquery.jobUser` if you plan to query results.

Maya Patel: awesome, thanks everyone :heart_eyes: — will wait. Quick q: is there a standard bucket naming we should use for EU compliance?

Leo Martins: yes — use `redwood-eu-<team>-<env>` pattern. I'll create the bucket if infra policy requires it and add retention tags.

Sarah Jansen: welcome again — HR scheduled a 1:1 in 30m. Ping me if anything blocks access.

Maya Patel: thanks all, appreciate the fast help :pray:
